metadata.description: Plugins for working with many AI agents: starling keeps sessions, accounts and worktrees safe; magpie hands queued work to your agents.

plugins.name: starling
plugins.description: Run many Claude Code sessions in parallel worktrees safely: blocks git stash, destructive git and polling loops, and repairs shared config across accounts.

plugins.name: magpie
plugins.description: Work your magpie queue from Claude Code: registers magpie's MCP server and teaches agents to take, finish and hand back queued items. Needs the magpie app or CLI installed.
